claim_boundary.native_reasoning_interpretation: This condition establishes the effect of requesting the model's high-reasoning option. It may be described as native reasoning only when response telemetry attests that the option was applied.
not_supported: Universal superiority across models, tasks, or domains
Causal attribution of all improvement to a single DOHAA component
Superiority over a standalone deterministic policy engine
Generalization beyond new instances of the five frozen administrative schemas
claim_boundary.statistical_interpretation: The exact sign-test p-value is used only as a preregistered decision rule on this fixed suite and must not be described as population-level significance or evidence of generalization.
claim_boundary.supported_if_successful: On this frozen 40-case synthetic administrative suite and the same local model/artifact declared by the operator but not independently attested, the complete DOHAA-controlled branch (LLM plus deterministic deployable policy validator and bounded repair) achieved higher strict correctness than the Direct branch starting from byte-identical initial proposals, under the preregistered paired analysis.
claim_boundary.unequal_compute_disclosure: The comparison is between deployable systems with different allowed computation. It does not establish equal-compute algorithmic superiority.

model_call_accounting.explanation: Shared initial inference reduces physical compute only; it is not counted as a semantic advantage.

prior_evidence.reason: Six of eight reported V2 DOHAA wins depended on oracle-only retry feedback.

system_interpretation.dohaa_system: LLM + deployable deterministic policy validator + bounded repair
system_interpretation.task_design_scope: New instances of five frozen administrative schemas; not wholly new task designs.
